Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.

Repeat from step 1.

When Scrivener enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.

Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Because the Treasures are Foods due to Gourmand's Talent, Unlucky Cabbage Merchant triggers three times. Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Unlucky Cabbage Merchant.
Resolve the first Unlucky Cabbage Merchant trigger, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 for the remaining Unlucky Cabbage Merchant triggers.
Repeat from step 1.

3259-7296-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
3259-7296-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7296-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Gimli's Reckless Might so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

Repeat from step 2

1021-2167-5231-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-2167-5231-6761.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Squandered Resources ability.
If you control three or more Scouring Swarms, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control two Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-2167-5231-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {1}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least three at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control four or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

Repeat from step 2.
